gloss: arts and sciences; learning and the arts

definitions.gloss: arts and sciences; learning and the arts
definitions.explanation: The combination of academic learning and creative arts, or scholarly and artistic pursuits in general.

examples.japanese: {学芸|がくげい}{員|いん}の{説明|せつめい}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I listened to the museum curator's explanation.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}で{学芸|がくげい}{会|かい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A school performance event will be held.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}は{学芸|がくげい}{学部|がくぶ}で{幅広|はばひろ}い{教養|きょうよう}{教育|きょういく}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: This university provides a broad liberal education in its faculty of arts and sciences.

notes:
Combines {学|がく} (learning/scholarship) and {芸|げい} (art/skill). Most commonly encountered in compound words rather than on its own. The two most frequent uses are {学芸|がくげい}{員|いん} (museum curator — an official certification in Japan) and {学芸|がくげい}{会|かい} (school arts/performance festival).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学芸|がくげい}{員|いん}: museum curator/curator
- {学芸|がくげい}{会|かい}: school arts festival/performance day
- {学芸|がくげい}{大学|だいがく}: university of arts and sciences (e.g., {東京|とうきょう}{学芸|がくげい}{大学|だいがく})
- {学芸|がくげい}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of arts and sciences

CULTURAL NOTE:
{学芸|がくげい}{会|かい} is a major event at Japanese schools where students put on plays, musical performances, and other presentations. It is distinct from {運動会|うんどうかい} (sports day) and {文化祭|ぶんかさい} (culture festival).
